caption: The drawing depicts the profile of a single human face oriented to the left, rendered in muted earth tones. The skin is shaded in light brown and tan, with reddish-brown shading on the cheek and lips. The eye is closed, and the eyebrow is strongly outlined in dark brown. The nose and lips are prominent, with soft rows of color emphasizing the contours of the face. The figure appears to wear a dark head covering that drapes down past the shoulder, colored in shades of black with subtle brown and gray highlights. Around the neck, there is a green and yellow scalloped collar above a garment colored in reddish-brown. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is handwritten text in green ink near the bottom right that reads, “MAJEL G. CHAPLIN TAOS, NEW MEXICO.”
title: Head of Guadalupe
